Madison brought to light the strict constructionist's view of both the Constitution and the Proclamation, demanding that Congress, not the president, had full authority over all foreign affairs except those areas specified in the Constitution.

The debate among Jefferson/Madison and Hamilton regarding the Proclamation is portrayed in the song " Cabinet Battle #2 " in the musical Hamilton.
